Los Angeles Lakers — injuries
Doncic has been ruled out for Sunday's game at Detroit due to lower-back tightness, Trevor Lane of LakersNation.com reports.
Doncic will be held out of the front end of this back-to-back set, with his next chance to suit up coming Monday at Atlanta. With the superstar floor general sidelined, Austin Reaves will likely see increased scoring and playmaking duties, while Quentin Grimes and Collin Sexton could see an uptick in minutes.
